protocol.ranking: Within each case a method is ranked by the mean objective of its feasible runs only if at least half of its runs (15 of 30; 5 of 10) are feasible; methods with fewer feasible runs receive the worst ranks, below all qualifying methods, ordered by their number of feasible runs (more = better, ties averaged). This removes the survivorship bias of ranking by the mean feasible objective.
protocol.run_level_score: mpce_results.goodness (objective if feasible; every infeasible run below every feasible run, infeasible runs ordered by minimum spacing)
protocol.paired_test: mpce_results.paired_vs (two-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank on seed-paired score differences, |d| <= 1e-9 dropped), Holm within the family of PSO-VNS comparisons
protocol.all_run_endpoint: feasible beats infeasible; both feasible: larger objective wins (tie if |d| <= 1e-9); both infeasible: tie; score (W + T/2)/n; exact sign test on W vs L
protocol.seeds: 1-30, stored runs only; no optimization rerun

tab:farm-I-stats.notes: p_z: Holm z test of average ranks vs PSO-VNS (8 comparisons); case-mean Wilcoxon: MR.case_mean_wilcoxon (Holm over 8); W/T/L: run-level, R2.wtl_block (Holm over the 8 comparisons of PSO-VNS per case); mean_dloss_pp = PSO-VNS minus method over the cases where both qualify (negative = PSO-VNS better)
